title: 第15章 法爷第16章 离开
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
;;
试炼的第三天，黄昏。
夕阳像是一团被揉碎的余烬，将灰语森林的树冠染成了暧昧的橘红色。
维克多坐在一棵巨大的红杉树横出的枝桠上，背靠着粗糙的树皮，双腿悬空，手里正摆弄着几团只有他能看见的幽幽绿光。
那是这三天来的收获——都是二阶魔物身上提取出的词条。
维克多像是在盘核桃一样，随手将一团标着【迅捷猎手】绿色光球拍进面板里。意念引导下，这团光芒顺着经络流向了代表【盲斗剑术】的技能节点。
视野角落的半透明面板只是微微闪烁了一下：
【盲斗剑术】的熟练度增加了23点。
已被同级词条附魔过的技能，喂再多相同等级的词条都只能加熟练度而已，不会让技能产生质变。
“应该是需要更高级别的词条。”
维克多摸了摸下巴，目光投向了森林深处那片更加幽暗、终年笼罩着灰雾的区域。
而蓝色词条，往往意味着……极度危险。
他的脑海中不禁浮现出那头变异野猪记忆里看到的画面：在那片连阳光都无法穿透的森林深处，泥土里搏动着血管般的纹路，空气中充斥着某种能让大脑颤抖的低语。
邪神的精神污染。
维克多理智地收回了目光。
冒险者协会为了保障试炼的难度，特意驱赶了一批相对强大的二阶魔物，可惜维克多狩猎了好几个，也都是绿色词条。
之前在外围区域竟然能捡到青岚座狼的漏，果真是撞了大运。
他拍了拍腰间鼓鼓囊囊的空间皮囊。那里装着足足八枚二阶魔物的魔核，以及剥取出来的各种关键部位。
就在维克多准备从树上跳下来，前往集合点时。
轰——！！！

远处，一阵剧烈的爆炸声打破了黄昏的宁静。紧接着，是一股灼热的气浪，连带着惊飞了无数栖息的飞鸟。
维克多动作一顿。
那个方向……离他不到五百米。
出于职业习惯，或者说某种看热闹不嫌事大的心态，维克多重新激活了身上的【噪点伪装】。他的身影在夕阳的余晖中晃动了一下，再次与树影融为一体，像一只无声的灵猫，悄无声息地向着爆炸源头摸了过去。
……
那是一片林间空地。
此时，这里正上演着一场充满了金钱味道的围猎。
被围攻的是一头体型接近三米的“暴熊”。这东西有着厚实的皮毛和惊人的怪力，一巴掌能拍碎岩石，算是二阶魔物里的重型坦克。
但这头暴熊现在很惨。
因为它面对的，是一支武装到牙齿的“少爷战队”。
四个身穿精良板甲的侍从骑士正举着大盾，死死地卡住了暴熊的活动空间。而在他们身后，一个身穿丝绸法袍、手持镶嵌着红宝石法杖的年轻金发男子，正一脸兴奋地吟唱着咒语。
“哦！伟大的火焰元素啊！请聆听您忠实仆人的呼唤……”
维克多蹲在一根高处的树枝上，有些无语地看着下面这一幕。
这个法师少爷的吟唱……也太长了吧？
足足过了五秒钟，那根法杖顶端才亮起一团橘红色的火光。
而且为了配合咒语的韵律，这位少爷还极其浮夸地挥舞着手臂，左脚跺地，右脚画圈，最后还要摆出一个帅气的投掷姿势，大喊一声：
“爆裂火球——去吧！！”
呼！
一颗脸盆大小的火球呼啸而出，狠狠地砸在被侍从死死压住的暴熊身上。
轰！

The third day of the trial, dusk.
The setting sun was like a ball of crushed embers, dyeing the canopy of the Gray Whisper Forest an ambiguous orange-red.
Victor was sitting on the branches of a huge redwood tree, leaning against the rough bark with his back, his legs dangling in the air, and he was playing with a few balls of faint green light that only he could see in his hands.
That's what I've gained in the past three days - all entries extracted from the second-level monsters.
Victor casually slapped a ball of green light marked [Swift Hunter] into the panel as if he was dishing walnuts. Under the guidance of his thoughts, this group of light flows along the meridians to the skill node representing [Blind Fighting Swordsmanship].
The translucent panel in the corner of the field of view only flickered slightly:
[Blind Fighting Swordsmanship] proficiency increased by 23 points.
For a skill that has been enchanted by an entry of the same level, adding more entries of the same level will only increase proficiency and will not cause a qualitative change in the skill.
"It should be that a higher level entry is needed."
Victor touched his chin and cast his gaze towards the darker area deep in the forest, shrouded in gray fog all year round.
And blue entries often mean... extremely dangerous.
The scene he saw in the memory of the mutated wild boar emerged in his mind: deep in the forest where even sunlight could not penetrate, the soil was pulsating with vein-like lines, and the air was filled with some kind of whisper that could make the brain tremble.
The spiritual pollution of the evil god.
Victor withdrew his gaze rationally.
In order to ensure the difficulty of the trial, the Adventurers Association deliberately drove away a group of relatively powerful second-level monsters. Unfortunately, Victor hunted several of them, and they were all green entries.
I was able to pick up Qinglan Warg's leak in the outer area before, which was really good luck.
He patted the bulging space skin around his waist. There are eight magic cores of second-level monsters, as well as various key parts that were stripped out.
Just when Victor was about to jump down from the tree and head to the meeting point.
boom--! ! !
In the distance, a violent explosion broke the tranquility of the dusk. Immediately afterwards, there was a scorching wave of air, which frightened countless birds flying away.
Victor made a move.
That direction... was less than five hundred meters away from him.
Out of professional habits, or a certain mentality of just watching the excitement without taking it too seriously, Victor reactivated the [Noise Camouflage] on his body. His figure swayed in the afterglow of the setting sun and merged with the shadow of the trees again. Like a silent civet, it quietly moved towards the source of the explosion.
…
It was a glade.
At this time, a hunt full of money is going on here.
The one being besieged was a "violent bear" nearly three meters in size. This thing has thick fur and amazing strength. It can smash rocks with one slap. It can be regarded as a heavy tank among the second-level monsters.
But this violent bear is now miserable.
Because what it faced was a "young master's team" armed to the teeth.
Four squire knights wearing fine plate armor were holding large shields, blocking the violent bear's movement space. Behind them, a young blond man wearing a silk robe and holding a ruby-encrusted staff was chanting a spell with excitement.
"Oh! O great elemental of fire! Please listen to the call of your faithful servant..."
Victor squatted on a high branch, watching the scene below speechlessly.
Isn't this Master Mage's chant... too long?
After a full five seconds, a ball of orange-red fire lit up at the top of the staff.
And in order to match the rhythm of the spell, the young master also waved his arms in an extremely exaggerated manner, stamped the ground with his left foot, drew circles with his right foot, and finally put on a handsome throwing posture and shouted:
"Explosive Fireball - Go!!"
Phew!
A fireball the size of a washbasin roared out and hit the violent bear who was pinned down by the attendant.
boom!
